report.summary: No published paper isolates the effect of adding a type/field layer to a code graph in an ablation. Closest works: CodexGraph (uses AST+CFG+PDG but no type/field ablation), GraphCodeBERT (uses data flow edges, not types), RepoHyper (hypergraph with AST+CFG+data flow, no type/field isolation), CPG/Joern (includes types but no retrieval/repair ablation), Aroma (AST-based clone search, no types). The gap is confirmed.

handoff.suggestion: Design an ablation study: compare LLM retrieval/repair with and without type/field edges in a code graph (e.g., using Joern's CPG). Measure recall@k for retrieval and pass@1 for repair on SWE-bench or similar. Report the delta.
